import base64
from io import BytesIO
from unittest import mock

import pytest
from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ChatMessage, ImageBlock
from llama_index.core.bridge.pydantic import BaseModel


PNG_1PX_B64 = b"iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
PNG_1PX = base64.b64decode(PNG_1PX_B64)


def test_repo_module_loaded():
    import llama_index.core.base.llms.types as t

    assert "/repo/llama-index-core/" in t.__file__


def test_default_encoding_base64():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX)
    assert b.encoding == "base64"
    assert b.image == PNG_1PX_B64


def test_raw_encoding_keeps_bytes():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX, encoding="raw")
    assert b.encoding == "raw"
    assert b.image == PNG_1PX


def test_get_image_mimetype_guessed():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX)
    assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"


def test_get_image_mimetype_explicit():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX, image_mimetype="image/jpeg")
    assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/jpeg"


def test_get_image_mimetype_cached():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX)
    with mock.patch("llama_index.core.base.llms.types.filetype.guess") as g:
        assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"
        assert b.get_image_mimetype() == "image/png"
        g.assert_not_called()


def test_get_image_mimetype_no_image():
    b = ImageBlock()
    assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None


def test_get_image_mimetype_unknown():
    b = ImageBlock(image=b"not an image")
    assert b.get_image_mimetype() is None


def test_raw_resolve_image():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX, encoding="raw")
    assert b.resolve_image().read() == PNG_1PX
    assert b.resolve_image(as_base64=True).read() == PNG_1PX_B64


def test_base64_resolve_image_unchanged():
    b = ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX)
    assert b.resolve_image().read() == PNG_1PX
    assert b.resolve_image(as_base64=True).read() == PNG_1PX_B64


def test_roundtrip_chatmessage_raw():
    m = ChatMessage(content=[ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX, encoding="raw")])
    dumped = m.model_dump()
    m2 = ChatMessage(**dumped)
    assert m2.blocks[0].image == PNG_1PX
    assert m2.blocks[0].encoding == "raw"


def test_roundtrip_chatmessage_base64():
    m = ChatMessage(content=[ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX)])
    dumped = m.model_dump()
    m2 = ChatMessage(**dumped)
    assert m2.blocks[0].image == PNG_1PX_B64


def test_invalid_encoding_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        ImageBlock(image=PNG_1PX, encoding="weird")
